title: Selective lysosomal H2O2–ROS imaging with a naphthalimide probe forming hydroxylamine without overoxidation

Hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) plays a central role in oxidative stress, signaling, and pathophysiology, yet its highly dynamic and compartmentalized distribution in living cells makes precise monitoring a major analytical challenge.
